category_title: Elementary students with ADHD and language delay who improve concentration and social helpfulness through virtual games
scenario_title: Distraction by interactive playground objects in convenience store
minimal_context: The student is starting Lesson 2 outside a virtual convenience store with the goal of entering to complete question-based learning tasks.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Let's start Lesson 2. Please go into the convenience store and complete the learning tasks.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Answers a few questions) Look at the kids walking outside the classroom!

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Let's keep going with the questions.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I answered six questions already. I want to stay out here.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please move on to completing the tasks.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Stays outside the convenience store) These objects are great fun to play with! Hey, let's play! (Plays with peers, attention totally distracted away from the learning process)
